tei:div.tei:p: (749)klong chen snying gi thig le lasaḥbaka' srung sman btsun mched lnga'i phrin las dpag bsam yongs 'du bzhugasaḥ (750)

ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sku la 'dudaḥ phyi ltar sman btsun mched lnga laḥ nang ltar rigs lnga'i ḍāk+ki niḥ gsang ba dbyings kyi yum chen moḥ bka' srung sman mo ltar sgrub pa'iḥ phrin las dpag bsam yongs 'du bstanaḥ sa ma yāḥ shin tu yid 'ong dben pa'i gnasaḥ nags tshal me tog bkra ba'i saraḥ 'khar ba'i me long che legs steng ཿ rang byung li khri'i thig le bskusaḥ dbus mdun nas brtsams g.yas bskor duḥ baṃ dang ha ri ni sa brisaḥ de steng rang byung shel dkar dang ཿ rma bya'i sgro mdangs dung (751) gi shwaḥ g.yu byang mig med sa le sbramaḥ rin chen snod blugs lding gur phubaḥ nyer spyod sman gtor rak+ta dang ཿ bza' btung sna tshogs mthar bskor bkramaḥ rig 'jin bla ma'i sa ma dhisaḥ kyaiḥ rang snang 'od gsal sprul pa'i gnasaḥ khor yug gangs ri'i phreng ba canaḥ shin tu yid 'ong skyed mos tshalaḥ ne'u seng me tog bkra ba'i dbusaḥ rin chen g.yu yi khang (752)bzang niḥ dngas gsal shel gyi them skas canaḥ byi ru'i kha bad mjes pa'i klong ཿ sna tshogs rat+na'i khri stengs suḥ dpa' bo yongs kyi sring gcig maḥ rig 'jin yongs kyi sgrub sde moḥ sman btsun bkra shis tshe ring maḥ rdo rje kun tu bzang mo niḥ dkar dmar mjes pa'i lang tsho canaḥ phyag g.yas yid bzhin nor bu dbang ཿ g.yon pa dma' dar dung sho canaḥ srid gsum gsal ba'i me long 'jinaḥ dar dkar na (753)gza' gsar ba'i steng ཿ rma bya'i sgro thul g.yang lugs gsolaḥ rat+na'i srog zhu dar thod canaḥ mjes sdug mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengasaḥ mdun du mthing gi zhal bzang maḥ snang gsal sra yi me long 'jinaḥ g.yas su cod pan mgrin bzang maḥ rin chen gter gyi bum pa bsnamasaḥ rgyab tu mi g.yo glang bzang maḥ rma g.yang nor gyi gzhong pa 'jinaḥ g.yon du gtal dkar 'gro (754)bzang maḥ dngul skyogs 'o mas gang ba bsnamasaḥ kun kyang g.yon pa rang rtags laḥ g.yas pa mda' dar g.yob pa'i tshulaḥ

dar dkar na bza' yang lugs gsolaḥ rin chen sna tshogs do shal mjesaḥ g.yon bskum gar gyi stabs su 'gying ཿ mtha' skor sprul pa yang sprul dang ཿ nying sprul bran g.yog bsam mi khyabaḥ gtso mo'i thugs las 'od 'phros pasaḥ nub phyogs o rgyan mkha' spyod zhing ཿ gnas (755)yul dur khrod lha'i 'dun paḥ gangs chen shel gyi zur phud sogasaḥ ma ges pad+ma'i sgrub gnas dang ཿ rang bzhin sprul pa'i gnas mchog nasaḥ spyan 'dren gnas 'dir da tshur byonaḥ badz+ra pra mo ha tsirta hriṃ hriṃ jaḥjaḥ hūm̐ḥ bzhengs shig chos sku'i klong yangs lasaḥ bskyod cig longs spyod rdzogs pa'i maḥ dgongs shig sprul pa'i gnas mchog 'diraḥ dam tshig gnyan pos da tshur byonaḥ 'da' dka' rdo rje'i (756)gdan la bzhugasaḥ nyams chag skong zhing zhig ral gsoḥ srog dang dam tshig gcig tu bsreḥ brtan par bzhugs la dngos grub stsolaḥ sa ma yaḥ tiṣ+ṭha lhanaḥ hūm̐ḥ bde chen chos sku'i klong yangs lasaḥ zhen med rang grol mchod pa'i sprinaḥ nyer spyod 'dod pa'i yon tan dang ཿ btung ba sna tshogs mtsho ltar bskyilaḥ sman gtor rak+ta phye mar spyodaḥ skyed tshal zas gos dkaro nor rdzasaḥ sha rkyang ma he 'dod 'jo'i baḥ (757)rdzu 'phrul shugs ldan dre'u sngoḥ rlung gi rtsal ldan cang shes rtaḥ spos kyi glang po 'brang g.yag zholaḥ sna tshogs dar gyi phur lding g.yoḥ rnga ma'i lding gur 'ja' ris 'khyilaḥ rma bya zlos gar bsgyur ba dang ཿ bya nag mchu ser la sogs paḥ mdor na sman mo mnyes pa'i rdzasaḥ ma tshang med pa mchod pa'i sprinaḥ mig 'phrul lta bu'i ting 'jin gyisaḥ nam mkha' mjod kyi 'khor lor 'bulaḥ dpal ldan lha (758)mo'i thugs dam bskang ཿ rdo rje bdud mo'i thugs dam bskang ཿ tshe ring mched lnga'i thugs dam bskang ཿ sprul pa yang sprul thugs dam bskang ཿ thugs dam bskangs la nyams chag solaḥ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod kyiḥ lta ba log na dbyings su gosaḥ

sgom pa yengs na rig pas skyong ཿ spyod pa nor na tshogs kyis bskang ཿ srog la bdud du ma 'bab cigaḥ snying la rlung du ma 'jug cigaḥ dbyings kyi rje mo (759)ma g.yel cigaḥ 'khor gyi rnam rtog ma 'khrul cigaḥ khyod ni 'khor 'das kun gyi bdagaḥ dga' na gdong ma'i sangs rgyas stonaḥ khros na gza' skar thang la 'bebasaḥ snod bcud 'byung ba'i byed pa moḥ dus bzhi kun gyi drod kyang 'jinaḥ bka' gsang gnyan po'i bya ra mjadaḥ mthu rtsal canal bdag bstod doḥ ༈ rgyal dbang pad+ma thod phreng dang ཿ rig 'jin brgyud dpa'i spyan snga ruḥ bstan pa bsrung bar khas (760)blangs bzhinaḥ theg chog rdzogs pa chen po dang ཿ khyad par 'od gsal snying thig 'di'iḥ bstan pa yar ngo'i zla ltar spelaḥ bstan 'jin skyes bu'i sku tshe dang ཿ mjad phrin nam mkha'i pha mthar brdolaḥ brgyud 'jin slob ma bu bzhin skyongasaḥ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mnga' thang bskyedaḥ gangs can bod kyi rgyal khams suḥ nad kha chos la dal kha sposaḥ dgra kha bsgyur la mtshon rtse thulaḥ char chu dus phobs btsa' (761)(762)than sogasaḥ mi mthun dus kyi rgud pa solaḥ mdor na yid la gang 'dod pa'iḥ bsam don lhun gyis grub par mjodaḥ ces brjod 'od zer drwa ba bcingasaḥ 'dod don mngon du sgrub par bsamaḥ baṃ ha ri ni sa badz+ra pra mo ha tsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ jaḥjaḥ ces bzla ting 'jin gnad nas bskulaḥ mtha' bsgyur gab yig bzhin du byaḥ las kun 'grub par the tshom medaḥ 'di nyid shin tu snying nye bsaḥ kun la sbyin par mi bya'oḥ sa ma yaḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥ rig 'jin 'jigs med gling pa'i dgongs klong nam mkha' mjod nas mngon du byung ba'o/ dge'o/// /
